title: ConsentAudit
description: A record of a specific event where a user gave or issued consent.

id.description: The unique ID of this audit record.

subject_id.description: The identity or subject of this consent.

org_id.description: The org id that owns this consent audit

project_id.description: The project id that owns this client.

app_id.description: The application id that made this request

client_id.description: The client id that made this request

session_id.description: The session id that if the user was answering multiple requests.

timestamp.description: The timestamp of this audit record.

skipped.description: If the consent was skipped due to existing business logic.

scopes.description: The scopes that were approved by the user.

experiments.description: The scopes requested by the application and reviewed by the user.

agent.description: The device that was used to initiate this request. See https://github.com/ua-parser/uap-java OR https://github.com/k143408/user-agent-parser-spring-boot-3
agent.title: ConsentAuditAgent

os.description: The OS that the user is using.
os.title: ConsentAuditAgentOs

name.description: The name of this OS agent

short_name.description: The short name for this agent

family.description: The product family of this agent

client.description: The client that the user is using.
client.title: ConsentAuditAgentClient

device.description: The device that the user is using.

id.description: The device the user is using

type.description: The type of device being used.

brand.description: The brand of the device being used.

model.description: The model of the device being used.

code.description: The device code of the device being used.

header.description: The raw user agent making this request.
